name: AirPods Pro (2nd Gen)
description: AirPods Pro feature up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Transparency, and Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking for immersive sound.

name: AirPods Max
description: AirPods Max combine high-fidelity audio with industry-leading Active Noise Cancellation to deliver an unparalleled listening experience with custom-built drivers.

name: HomePod
description: HomePod is a powerhouse of a speaker. Acoustic engineering and computational audio work together to deliver groundbreaking, room-filling sound.

name: HomePod Mini
description: The HomePod mini is jam-packed with innovation, delivering unexpectedly big sound for a speaker of its size. At just 3.3 inches tall, it takes up almost no space but fills the entire room with rich 360-degree audio. It works effortlessly with your iPhone—hand off music just by bringing your phone close to the speaker. You can place multiple HomePod mini speakers around the house for a connected sound system.

name: iPhone 15 Pro
tagline: Titanium. So strong. So light. So Pro.
description: Forged in titanium and featuring the groundbreaking A17 Pro chip, a customizable Action button, and the most powerful iPhone camera system ever.

name: MacBook Pro 14"
description: MacBook Pro blasts forward with the M3 chip, extreme battery life, and a stunning Liquid Retina XDR display for demanding workflows.

name: iPad Air
description: iPad Air features a 10.9-inch Liquid Retina display, supercharged M1 chip, ultra-fast wireless, and support for Apple Pencil and Magic Keyboard.
